title: Damage Type
description: A damage type in the combat system. Categories: physical (slashing/piercing/bludgeoning), elemental (fire/frost/shock/acid/poison), energy (necrotic/radiant/psychic/force/thunder). Each damage type may carry tags for resistance, phase interaction, and special properties.

category.description: Broad classification. physical = bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. elemental = fire/frost/shock/acid/poison. energy = necrotic/radiant/psychic/force/thunder.

tags.description: Tags for resistance matching, phase interaction, and special rules. Common tags: 'armor_dr_applies' (physical only), 'bypasses_armor' (energy/mental), 'phase_wood', 'phase_fire', etc.
